 This application coming on for admission this day, th e   the following:
 ORDER

This is the First application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the applicant in connection with Crime No. 52/2024, registered at Police Station : Gourjhamar, Distt. Sagar for the offences under Sections 363, 366A, 376 of IPC and Section 3/4 of the P.O.C.S.O. Act.
2.

It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is suffering confinement since 12/2/2024 and charge sheet has already been filed, therefore, chance of tampering with evidence/ witnesses is remote.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix and applicant shared emotional and physical proximity with consent.

It appears that she left her maternal home on her Ankit vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32726150/
1 own volition on motorcycle with applicant.

sentences.text: Medical report belies the allegations as no injuries in specific terms suggesting offence of rape is found over the person of prosecutrix.
Applicant is a boy aged about 19 years without criminal antecedents.
Confinement amounts to pre-trial detention.
He undertakes not to be a source of embarrassment and harassment to the prosecutrix in any manner and shall neither move in the vicinity of the prosecutrix nor shall try to contact her in any manner,
Under these grounds, learned counsel prayed for grant of bail to the applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the respondent/State as well as complainant opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
5.

Considering the submissions and the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties,
without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
(vii) The applicant shall not be a source of embarrassment and harassment to the prosecutrix in any manner and shall not move in her vicinity.
( v i i i ) The applicant shall not try to contact the prosecutrix in person, through electronic mode or through somebody else otherwise benefit of bail shall immediately be withdrawn.
(ix) The applicant shall mark his presence on first Sunday of every month before the concerned police station between 10:00 am to 2:30 pm till conclusion of trial.
